en: Color‑tinted vintage street view showing a long, straight avenue lined with two‑ and three‑story colonial-style buildings with balconies. Well‑dressed pedestrians, mostly men in suits and hats, walk along the sidewalks. In the distance stands a clock tower or church tower centered at the end of the street. The caption at the top identifies the location as Calle Sucre in Cochabamba, Bolivia. There is also a hanging commercial sign on the right side of the street.
